standardsBody: ISO 4762 and DIN 912 describe the same hexagon socket head cap screw. DIN 912 has been withdrawn in favor of ISO 4762, and German distributors now list the ISO number first; we mark every size with both so your purchase order matches either. Fine-pitch versions fall under ISO 12474. Property classes follow ISO 898-1: our M6 × 20 in class 12.9 tests at ≥ 1,220 MPa tensile strength. US buyers: all sizes are metric; each model page shows the inch conversion of thread and length for cross-reference.

standardsBody: DIN 6921 covers hexagon bolts with an integral flange, with or without underhead serration. The flange spreads the clamp load over a larger area, so no separate washer is needed, and the serrated version resists loosening under vibration. Property classes follow ISO 898-1; our M8 × 25 in class 10.9 is zinc-flake coated to ≥ 720 h salt spray. Zinc flake is applied without electrolysis, which is why it is the usual choice for class 10.9 and higher where hydrogen embrittlement must be avoided. US buyers: metric sizes with inch conversions on each model page; class 10.9 is commonly cross-referenced to SAE Grade 8.
processTitle: How we make and check them
processBody: Made: cold-headed with the flange formed in the die, threads rolled. Heat-treated: hardened and tempered in-house to class 10.9. Coated: zinc flake (Dacromet-type), salt-spray tested in our own chamber to ≥ 720 h. Sorted: 100% optical sorting on automotive orders. Certificates: ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949 [待确认：证书扫描件]; EN 10204 3.1 per size on request.

standardsBody: Self-tapping screws cut or form their own thread in a pre-drilled hole, which removes the nut and the tapping operation from assembly. Two families exist: thread-forming screws for ductile materials such as steel sheet and aluminum, and thread-cutting screws for harder or brittle materials. Tapping screws for sheet metal are most often specified to DIN 7981 / ISO 7049 (pan head) and DIN 7982 / ISO 7050 (countersunk). Standards, sizes and head styles in production: [待确认：标准号与规格，D16]. Property class does not apply; performance is specified by surface hardness and drive torque to the relevant standard. US buyers: inch-series tapping screws [待确认：是否供应英制，D20].

standardsBody: Property class 10.9 to ISO 898-1 is the usual choice for chassis, powertrain and body bolting: stronger than 8.8, less sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement than 12.9. The first digit of the class gives the nominal tensile strength, the second the yield-to-tensile ratio. Our 10.9 flange bolts are zinc-flake coated to ≥ 720 h salt spray; the coating is applied without electrolysis, which removes the embrittlement risk of electroplating. Every automotive order runs through 100% optical sorting, and the factory holds IATF 16949 [待确认：证书扫描件]. US buyers: class 10.9 is commonly cross-referenced to SAE Grade 8; all sizes are metric, with inch conversions on each model page.
